# Abrupt daemon death loses process ownership; Unknown cannot authorize a retry.
server start
custody listen
retry-task task.json hold 1
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-id retry-restart
job-id JOB
await-file first
# The test holds the workload's own pidfd before the daemon dies.
custody acquire
server crash
server start
await-state $JOB unknown
history unknown
! exists second
! skygo --json run -f task.json --request-id retry-restart --wait
stdout '"id": *"'$JOB'"'
stdout '"state": *"JOB_STATE_UNKNOWN"'
history unknown
! exists second
# The killed daemon cannot stop its surviving workload, and recovery never
# signals it. Release it and require its pidfd to report exit.
custody release
# With the original workload gone, nothing remains that could run attempt two.
skygo --json jobs get $JOB
stdout '"state": *"JOB_STATE_UNKNOWN"'
history unknown
! exists second
server stop
! stderr .
